slides.texte_overlay:
Why every man should
go camping alone once
You learn to rely on yourself. Pitching the tent, cooking, finding water. Every small task done alone builds real confidence.
You hear your own thoughts again. No phone signal, no notifications. After a day, your mind slows down and gets clearer.
You notice nature properly. Birds at dawn, stars at night, the sound of wind. Things you never notice in the city.
You get comfortable with discomfort. A cold night or a little rain teaches you that you can handle more than you think.
Before: silence made me restless. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and quiet time feels like a gift now.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: silence made me restless. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Quiet time feels like a gift now.

slides.texte_overlay: You come back grateful. A hot shower, a soft bed, a good meal. Simple comforts feel amazing after a night outside.
Start small and safe. A campsite near home, good weather, someone who knows your plan. Adventure doesn't need to be risky.
